title: InkPi project configuration
description: Configuration loaded from inkpi.config.json by the InkPi CLI.

$schema.description: Optional editor metadata. The CLI does not fetch or validate this value; use a relative schema path where possible.

name.description: Optional project name. Must contain a non-whitespace character.

version.description: Optional project version label. InkPi does not enforce semantic-version syntax.

defaultModel.description: Optional default model identifier; runtime availability is resolved separately.

typography.description: Optional typography settings, or false to disable typography formatting.

indentString.description: Optional indentation string used by typography formatting.
